summary: Iteration_15 validates (a) Phase-F final extraction of operational endpoints into routes/operations.py and (b) the new Founder Walkthrough overlay on /dashboard. Backend full pytest suite: 152 passed + 1 skipped (no regressions across test_equinesync, test_invites_and_analytics, test_onboarding, test_owner_trust, test_owner_trust_edges, test_phase2, test_reports_and_nudges, test_task_engine, test_weekly_recap, test_wellness_pulse, test_care_routes). Added dedicated /app/backend/tests/test_operations_routes.py with 13 assertions covering every endpoint moved to routes/operations.py — lessons GET/POST, training GET/POST + ?horse_id filter, invoices GET/POST + /pay, messages GET/POST (from_user_id + from_name + read=false stamping), service-requests GET/POST + approve (happy path with trainer token; 409 on re-approve; 403 for groom) + decline (200-char reason capped at 500; 409 on re-decline; 403 for groom; 404 for unknown id), incidents GET/POST with reported_by stamp. All 13 PASS. No _id leakage in any response. Auth gate on /api/lessons returns 401. server.py is now 833 LOC; routes/operations.py is 233 LOC including 8 Pydantic models. build_operations_router is correctly wired after build_care_router at line 691. Frontend Founder Walkthrough fully verified live as admin: auto-open fires on /dashboard mount when localStorage 'equinesync.walkthrough.seen' is absent and user.role=admin & progress.completed=true; walkthrough-launch button visible regardless; X button (walkthrough-close), Escape key, backdrop click (target===currentTarget guard verified at x=1200 outside the max-w-xl card) all close the modal; all 6 walkthrough-dot-{0..5} render; eyebrows match verbatim — 'Step 1 of 6 · Morning' / 'Step 2 of 6 · Morning' / 'Step 3 of 6 · Late morning' / 'Step 4 of 6 · Afternoon' / 'Step 5 of 6 · Evening' / 'Step 6 of 6 · You\'re ready'; titles match verbatim. Each step's walkthrough-cta-{id} link is present (today/feed/meds/timeline/digest/ready); clicking walkthrough-cta-today navigates to /today AND closes the modal. Step 6 shows walkthrough-finish (no walkthrough-next); clicking 'I\'ve got it' closes the modal and persists localStorage 'equinesync.walkthrough.seen=1'. After finish + reload /dashboard, the modal does NOT auto-open but launcher remains. For groom (non-setup role) with cleared localStorage, modal does NOT auto-open but launcher button is still present and manual open works. Network audit captured ZERO non-auth /api writes during the entire walkthrough exercise — the overlay is read-only as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/operations.py is a clean lift-and-shift — 8 Pydantic models (LessonIn, TrainingSessionIn, InvoiceIn, MessageIn, ServiceRequestIn, DeclineSRBody, IncidentIn) moved alongside handlers with identical shapes, identical role gating, identical 409/403/404 semantics. Helpers (db, get_current_user, list_collection, clean, new_id) injected via build_router — same pattern as care/dashboard/reports/invites/onboarding routers. Excellent consistency.

Service-request approve/decline: role check is uniform (admin|barn_manager|trainer), 404 precedes 409 (correctness), decline_reason is truncated to 500 chars via reason[:500] — verified live with 700-char input returning a 500-char stored reason. Pending guard matches spec ('Request is already approved/declined').
POST /api/messages stamps from_user_id, from_name, created_at, read=False — verified via test_messages_create_stamps_sender. POST /api/incidents stamps reported_by from user.full_name — verified.

Founder Walkthrough is genuinely read-only: only GETs to /tasks/today (steps 1&2), /dashboard/summary (step 3), /horses (step 4). Network monitor captured zero POST/PATCH/DELETE during the full 6-step traversal. The single mutation surface — localStorage.setItem('equinesync.walkthrough.seen','1') — fires exclusively from finish().

Auto-open useEffect dependency array [user, progress] is correct, walkthroughSeen() short-circuits returning users, and the role gate is admin|barn_manager only — groom verified to NOT auto-open while still seeing the launcher.
Eyebrow + body copy is calm hospitality tone as specified — no marketing language, no urgency triggers. Final step 'I\'ve got it' phrasing matches spec exactly.

server.py cumulative reduction confirmed real: 833 LOC vs 1949 at Phase-F start (~57% reduction). No leftover operations Pydantic models (LessonIn/TrainingSessionIn/InvoiceIn/MessageIn/ServiceRequestIn/IncidentIn) remain in server.py — verified by grep.

MINOR: existing test files test_invites_and_analytics.py and test_onboarding.py call os.environ.get('REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL').rstrip('/') at module-level — this raises AttributeError during collection if the env var isn't set. Not a regression from this iteration, but worth a future hardening pass (use os.environ.get('...', '').rstrip('/') or pytest.skip in fixture).

success_rate.backend: 152/152 passed + 1 skipped (full suite) + 13/13 new operations regression = 100%
success_rate.frontend: 100% — all walkthrough testids (launcher, modal, close, dots 0-5, ctas today/feed/meds/timeline/digest/ready, next, prev, finish) resolved; auto-open + persistence + no-reopen + role gating + zero-write audit all green

context_for_next_testing_agent: Operations endpoints now live in /app/backend/routes/operations.py (233 LOC). server.py is at 833 LOC. The regression file is /app/backend/tests/test_operations_routes.py — keep it in the suite. Note: existing test_invites_and_analytics.py and test_onboarding.py require REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var to be set BEFORE running pytest (use `cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://barn-ops-preview.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest tests/`). Founder Walkthrough is a pure overlay — localStorage key is 'equinesync.walkthrough.seen', dot testids are walkthrough-dot-{0..5}, CTA testids are walkthrough-cta-{today|feed|meds|timeline|digest|ready}. To exercise auto-open: clear localStorage and visit /dashboard as admin or barn_manager with onboarding.completed=true. The walkthrough makes ZERO non-GET API calls — preserve this invariant. No outstanding bugs.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failures. Phase-F operations extraction is behavior-preserving (verified by 13 dedicated assertions + 152 untouched suite tests). Founder Walkthrough delivers exactly per spec: read-only narration, calm copy, single localStorage persistence on finish.
